surface: Codex in-app browser, production Vite preview at http://127.0.0.1:4173/
evidenceClass: Observed WebGPU runtime with ordinary browser input
observations: Title, settings and controls are drawn in the game canvas; browser area has no webpage framing, with aspect-preserving letterboxing.
Arrow inputs moved the player during live waves. Browser samples record changing position, score, kills, damage and repair pickups.
Space through the browser locator activated Nova and its recharge. AX lower-case space did not send the intended input and is excluded from Nova evidence.
The ordinary-input run reached Gatebreaker at 90 seconds with four hull, then died at 103.9 seconds after browser input stopped between tool calls. This was not a completed browser win.
Death result displayed score 52450, kills 95 and best 52450. Enter started a clean five-hull, zero-score run; Escape paused it at time zero.
Pause samples remained stable. Return to title displayed the title; an incorrect accessible screen state on this path was found and sent for a focused fix.
The game's error panel was empty at the end of the ordinary-input run. This is not a claim that every browser diagnostic channel was inspected.
limitations: No human acceptance or human difficulty verdict.
Audio assets and scoped mixer were implemented and tested; no claim of human listening or audible mix quality.
No physical held-key, gamepad, mobile, cross-browser or broad hardware performance certification.
The first stage's complete win path is established separately by headless normal-rules runs and result-path fixtures.
The nova.jpg clip has an incorrect crop offset and is not a representative full-game screenshot.
